From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: New vendor tax package to begin PO (Lazuli Tech)

Thanks for the W-9, David — uploading to the vendor record now. Two quick items I want to flag before we can release the PO:

1) EIN mismatch check: the W-9's EIN ends with "1234" which matches our quote, but the vendor profile previously created by ops shows a different EIN (ends with "9876"). Finance needs a short confirmation from Lazuli that the EIN on the submitted W-9 is the official tax ID for this legal entity.

2) Signatory authority: the W-9 appears completed but there is no explicit signer name/title in the signature block (just a signature image). Procurement policy requires either:
   - a completed Signatory Authorization (signed by a corporate officer) OR
   - a DocuSign envelope showing the signer is the CFO/authorized signer OR
   - a corporate resolution scanned copy.

I attached a Signatory_Authority_Form template for Lazuli to fill if that is easiest. Monica / Grace — can you confirm that Finance will hold the PO until the signatory is verified? If yes, I'll mark the ticket and request the vendor provide the DocuSign route (preferred).

Next steps for vendor: please send either the completed Signatory Authorization or a DocuSign link with the signer's title (CFO, Treasurer) visible. If they want to redact their EIN in transit, ask them to provide a secure DocuSign link or portal upload.

Attachments:
- Signatory_Authority_Form.xlsx (template)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Looping in David per Tessa's note. Finance policy: we cannot push a PO live to the supplier bank account until we have both
- tax ID verification (matching EIN on W-9 to vendor legal entity) and
- signer authority confirmation.

Action items for Lazuli (to unblock PO):
1) Provide a DocuSign link for the W-9 that shows signer name + title (CFO or delegated officer). DocuSign is preferred because it gives us an audit trail.
2) If DocuSign isn't possible, return the attached Signatory_Authority_Form completed and signed by an officer with a corporate email domain AND a scanned corporate resolution (one-page is OK).

We will place the PO in "Ready - Awaiting Signoff" status (PROC-12345) and will transition to "Issued" once both items are received and verified. Grace — Finance will manually check the EIN across IRS/TIN vendor verification tools once we get the documents.

David — if you can send the DocuSign link or signed form today, we should be able to finish verification tomorrow and release the PO.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Vendor Operations / Procurement
Redwood Inference
